Arabic text: بِسْمِ اللَّـهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَحَصِّنْ ثُغُورَ الْمُسْلِمِيْنَ بِعِزَّتِكَ
Translation: And fortify the borders of the Muslims with Your might

Arabic text: وَأَيِّدْ حُمَاتَهَا بِقُوَّتِكَ
Translation: And support their defenders with Your strength

Arabic text: وَأَسْبِغَ عَطَايَاهُمْ مِنْ جِدَتِكَ
Translation: And grant them abundant gifts from Your bounty

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَكَثِّرْ عِدَّتَهُمْ، وَاشْحَذْ أَسْلِحَتَهُمْ
Translation: And increase their numbers, and sharpen their weapons

Arabic text: وَاحْرُسْ حَوْزَتَهُمْ، وَامْنَعْ حَوْمَتَهُمْ
Translation: And guard their territory, and defend their sanctuary

Arabic text: وَأَلِّفْ جَمْعَهُمْ، وَدَبِّرْ أَمْرَهُمْ
Translation: And unite their groups, and manage their affairs

Arabic text: وَوَاتِرْ بَيْنَ مِيَرِهِمْ، وَتَوَحَّدْ بِكِفَايَةِ مَؤَنِهِمْ
Translation: And provide them with continuous supplies, and take charge of fulfilling their needs

Arabic text: وَاعْضُدْهُمْ بِالنَّصْرِ، وَأَعْنِهُمْ بِالصَّبْرِ
Translation: And support them with victory, and aid them with patience

Arabic text: وَالْطُفْ لَهُمْ فِيْ الْمَكْرِ
Translation: And grant them subtlety in strategy

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَعَرِّفْهُمْ مَا يَجْهَلُونَ
Translation: And teach them what they do not know

Arabic text: وَعَلِّمْهُمْ مَا لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ
Translation: And instruct them in what they do not understand

Arabic text: وَبَصِّرْهُمْ مَا لَا يُبْصِرُونَ
Translation: And show them what they do not see

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَأَنْسِهِمْ عِنْدَ لِقَآئِهِمُ الْعَدُوَّ
Translation: And when they meet the enemy, make them forget

Arabic text: ذِكْرَ دُنْيَاهُمُ الْخَدَّاعَةِ الْغَرُورِ
Translation: The memory of the deceptive and deceiving world

Arabic text: وَامْحُ عَنْ قُلُوبِهِمْ خَطَرَاتِ الْمَالِ الْفَتُونِ
Translation: And erase from their hearts the thoughts of tempting wealth

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلِ الْجَنَّةَ نَصْبَ أَعْيُنِهِمْ وَلَوِّحْ مِنْهَا لْأِبْصَارِهِمْ
Translation: And place Paradise before their eyes and display to their vision

Arabic text: مَا أَعْدَدْتَ فِيهَا مِنْ مَسَاكِنِ الْخُلْدِ وَمَنَازِلِ الْكَرَامَةِ
Translation: What You have prepared therein of eternal dwellings and stations of honor

Arabic text: وَالْحُورِ الْحِسَانِ وَالْاَنْهَارِ الْمُطَّرِدَةِ بِأَنْوَاعِ الْاَشْرِبَـةِ
Translation: And beautiful companions and flowing rivers with various drinks

Arabic text: وَالْاَشْجَارِ الْمُتَدَلِّيَةِ بِصُنُوفِ الثَّمَرِ
Translation: And trees laden with different fruits

Arabic text: حَتَّى لَا يَهُمَّ أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمْ بِالْأَدْبَارِ
Translation: So that none of them would think of retreating

Arabic text: وَلَا يُحَدِّثَ نَفْسَهُ عَنْ قِرْنِهِ بِفِرَار
Translation: Or consider fleeing from their opponents

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ افْلُلْ بِذٰلِكَ عَدُوَّهُمْ
Translation: O Allah, through this, defeat their enemy

Arabic text: وَاقْلِمْ عَنْهُمْ أَظْفَارَهُمْ، وَفَرِّقْ بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ أَسْلِحَتِهِمْ
Translation: And blunt their claws, and separate them from their weapons

Arabic text: وَاخْلَعْ وَثَائِقَ أَفْئِدَتِهِمْ، وَبَاعِدْ بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ أَزْوِدَتِهِمْ
Translation: And remove courage from their hearts, and distance them from their provisions

Arabic text: وَحَيِّرْهُمْ فِيْ سُبُلِهِمْ، وَضَلِّلْهُمْ عَنْ وَجْهِهِمْ
Translation: And cause them to be confused in their paths, and lead them astray from their direction

Arabic text: وَاقْـطَعْ عَنْهُمُ الْمَدَدَ وَانْقُصْ مِنْهُمُ الْعَدَدَ
Translation: And cut off reinforcements from them and decrease their numbers

Arabic text: وَامْلَأْ أَفْئِدَتَهُمُ الرُّعْبَ، وَاقْبِضْ أَيْـدِيَهُمْ عَنِ البَسْطِ
Translation: And fill their hearts with terror, and restrain their hands from fighting

Arabic text: وَاخْـزِمْ أَلْسِنَتَهُمْ عَنِ النُّطْقِ
Translation: And tie their tongues from speaking

Arabic text: وَشَرِّدْ بهِمْ مَنْ خَلْفَهُمْ، وَنَكِّلْ بِهِمْ مَنْ وَرَاءَهُمْ
Translation: And scatter through them those who are behind them, and make an example of them for those who follow

Arabic text: وَاقْـطَعْ بِخِزْيِهِمْ أَطْمَـاعَ مَنْ بَعْدَهُمْ
Translation: And through their humiliation, cut off the aspirations of those who come after them

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ عَقِّمْ أَرْحَامَ نِسَائِهِمْ
Translation: O Allah, make the wombs of their women barren

Arabic text: وَيَبِّسْ أَصْلاَبَ رِجَالِهِمْ
Translation: And dry up the loins of their men

Arabic text: وَاقْطَعْ نَسْلَ دَوَابِّهِمْ وَأَنْعَامِهِمْ
Translation: And cut off the offspring of their animals and livestock

Arabic text: لَا تَأْذَنْ لِسَمَائِهِمْ فِيْ قَطْر، وَلَا لْأَرْضِهِمْ فِيْ نَبَات
Translation: Do not permit their skies to rain, nor their land to grow vegetation

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ وَقَوِّ بِذٰلِكَ مِحَالَّ أَهْلِ الْإِسْلاَمِ
Translation: O Allah, strengthen thereby the positions of the people of Islam

Arabic text: وَحَصِّنْ بِهِ دِيَارَهُمْ، وَثَمِّرْ بِـهِ أَمْوَالَهُمْ
Translation: And fortify their homes, and increase their wealth

Arabic text: وَفَرِّغْهُمْ عَنْ مُحَارَبَتِهِمْ لِعِبَادَتِكَ وَعَنْ مُنَابَذَتِهِمْ لِلْخَلْوَةِ بِكَ
Translation: And free them from fighting so they may worship You, and from battle so they may be alone with You

Arabic text: حَتَّى لَا يُعْبَدَ فِيْ بِقَاعِ الَارْضِ غَيْرُكَ
Translation: Until none is worshipped in any part of the earth except You

Arabic text: وَلَا تُعَفَّرَ لِأَحَدٍ مِنْهُمْ جَبْهَةٌ دُونَكَ
Translation: And no forehead is bowed before anyone other than You

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ اغزُ بِكُلِّ نَـاحِيَـة مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِيْنَ
Translation: O Allah, send the Muslims in every region

Arabic text: عَلَى مَنْ بِـإِزَائِهِمْ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
Translation: Against those polytheists who face them

Arabic text: وَأَمْدِدْهُمْ بِمَلَائِكَة مِنْ عِنْدِكَ مُرْدِفِينَ
Translation: And support them with angels from Your presence, coming in succession

Arabic text: حَتَّى يَكْشِفُـوهُمْ إِلَى مُنْقَطَعِ التُّـرَابِ قَتْـلًا فِيْ أَرْضِكَ
Translation: Until they pursue them to the ends of the land, killing them on Your earth

Arabic text: أَسْرًا أَوْ يُقِرُّوَا بِأَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ الَّذِيْ لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
Translation: Or taking them captive, or until they confess that You are Allah, there is no god but You

Arabic text: وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
Translation: Alone, without any partner

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ وَاعْمُمْ بِذٰلِكَ أَعْدَاءَكَ فِيْ أَقْطَارِ الْبِلاَدِ
Translation: O Allah, include in this all Your enemies in all regions of the lands

Arabic text: مِنَ الْهِنْدِ وَالرُّومِ وَالتُّـرْكِ وَالْخَزَرِ وَالْحَبَشِ
Translation: From the Hindus, Romans, Turks, Khazars, and Ethiopians

Arabic text: وَالنُّـوبَةِ وَالـزِّنْجِ وَالسَّقَالِبَةِ وَالدَّيَالِمَةِ
Translation: And the Nubians, Zanj, Slavs, and Dailamites

Arabic text: وَسَائِرِ أُمَمِ الشِّرْكِ الَّذِيْ تَخْفَى أَسْمَاؤُهُمْ وَصِفَاتُهُمْ
Translation: And all other polytheistic nations whose names and attributes are hidden

Arabic text: وَقَدْ أَحْصَيْتَهُمْ بِمَعْرِفَتِكَ، وَأَشْرَفْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِقُدْرَتِكَ
Translation: But You have counted them with Your knowledge, and You oversee them with Your power

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ اشْغَلِ الْمُشْرِكِينَ بِالمُشْرِكِينَ عَنْ تَنَاوُلِ أَطْرَافِ الْمُسْلِمِيْنَ
Translation: O Allah, occupy the polytheists with other polytheists, so they cannot harm the Muslims

Arabic text: وَخُذْهُمْ بِـالنَّقْصِ عَنْ تَنَقُّصِهِمْ
Translation: And diminish their numbers so they cannot diminish the Muslims

Arabic text: وَثَبِّطْهُمْ بِـالْفُـرْقَـةِ عَنِ الْإِحْتِشَادِ عَلَيْهِمْ
Translation: And discourage them through division from gathering against the Muslims

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ أَخْلِ قُلُوبَهُمْ مِنَ الْاَمَنَـةِ
Translation: O Allah, empty their hearts of security

Arabic text: وَأَبْدَانَهُمْ مِنَ الْقُوَّةِ وَأَذْهِلْ قُلُوبَهُمْ عَنِ الْإِحْتِيَالِ
Translation: And their bodies of strength, and distract their hearts from planning

Arabic text: وَأَوْهِنْ أَرْكَانَهُمْ عَنْ مُنَازَلَةِ الرِّجَالِ
Translation: And weaken their resolve against fighting brave men

Arabic text: وَجَبِّنْهُمْ عَنْ مُقَارَعَةِ الْاَبْطَالِ
Translation: And make them too cowardly to face the heroes

Arabic text: وَابْعَثْ عَلَيْهِمْ جُنْدًا مِنْ مَلَائِكَتِكَ
Translation: And send against them an army of Your angels

Arabic text: بِبَأس مِنْ بَأْسِكَ كَفِعْلِكَ يَوْمَ بَدْر
Translation: With a might from Your might, as You did on the day of Badr

Arabic text: تَقْطَعُ بِهِ دَابِرَهُمْ وَتَحْصُدُ بِهِ شَوْكَتَهُمْ
Translation: To cut off their roots and destroy their strength

Arabic text: وَتُفَرِّقُ بهِ عَدَدَهُمْ
Translation: And scatter their numbers

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ وَامْزُجْ مِيَاهَهُمْ بِالْوَبَاءِ وَأطْعِمَتَهُمْ بِالْاَدْوَاءِ
Translation: O Allah, mix their waters with plague and their food with disease

Arabic text: وَارْمِ بِلاَدَهُمْ بِالْخُسُوفِ وَأَلِـحَّ عَلَيْهَا بِـالْقُذُوفِ وَافْـرَعْهَا بِالْمُحُولِ
Translation: And strike their lands with earthquakes, pelt them with stones, and afflict them with drought

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلْ مِيَرَهُمْ فِيْ أَحَصِّ أَرْضِكَ وَأَبْعَـدِهَا عَنْهُمْ
Translation: And place their provisions in the most barren and distant parts of Your land

Arabic text: وَامْنَـعْ حُصُونَهَا مِنْهُمْ، أَصِبْهُمْ بِالْجُوعِ الْمُقِيْمِ وَالسُّقْمِ الَالِيمِ
Translation: And keep their fortresses away from them, afflict them with perpetual hunger and painful illness

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ وَأَيُّمَا غَازٍ غَزَاهُمْ مِنْ أَهْلِ مِلَّتِكَ
Translation: O Allah, for any warrior who fights them from the people of Your religion

Arabic text: أَوْ مُجَاهِد جَاهَدَهُمْ مِنْ أَتْبَاعِ سُنَّتِكَ لِيَكُونَ دِينُكَ الَاعْلَى
Translation: Or any fighter who strives against them from the followers of Your way, so that Your religion may be supreme

Arabic text: وَحِزْبُكَ الْأَقوَى وَحَظُّكَ الَاوْفَى فَلَقِّهِ الْيُسْرَ
Translation: And Your party strongest, and Your share most complete - make ease for them

Arabic text: وَهَيِّئْ لَهُ الْأَمْرَ، وَتَوَلَّهُ بِالنُّجْحِ
Translation: And prepare the matter for them, and grant them success

Arabic text: وَتَخَيَّرْ لَهُ الْأَصْحَابَ، وَاسْتَقْوِ لَهُ الظَّهْرَ
Translation: And choose for them good companions, and strengthen their support

Arabic text: وَأَسْبِغْ عَلَيْهِ فِيْ النَّفَقَةِ وَمَتِّعْهُ بِالنَّشَاطِ
Translation: And provide them with ample spending, and grant them enthusiasm

Arabic text: وَأَطْفِ عَنْهُ حَرَارَةَ الشَّوْقِ، وَأَجِرْهُ مِنْ غَمِّ الْوَحْشَةِ
Translation: And extinguish from them the heat of longing, and protect them from the grief of loneliness

Arabic text: وَأَنْسِهِ ذِكْرَ الَاهْلِ وَالْوَلَدِ وَأَثُرْ لَهُ حُسْنَ النِّيَّةِ وَتَوَلَّه بِالْعَافِيَةِ
Translation: And make them forget the memory of family and children, and grant them good intention and well-being

Arabic text: وَأَصْحِبْهُ السَّلاَمَةَ، وَأَعْفِهِ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ
Translation: And accompany them with safety, and protect them from cowardice

Arabic text: وَأَلْهِمْهُ الْجُرْأَةَ وَارْزُقْهُ الشِّدَّةَ وَأَيِّدْهُ بِالنُّصْرَةِ
Translation: And inspire them with courage, and grant them strength, and support them with victory

Arabic text: وَعَلِّمْهُ السِّيَرَ وَالسُّنَنَ، وَسَدِّدْهُ فِيْ الْحُكْمِ
Translation: And teach them the ways and traditions, and guide them in judgment

Arabic text: وَاعْزِلْ عَنْهُ الرِّيَاءَ، وَخَلِّصْهُ مِنَ السُّمْعَةِ
Translation: And remove from them showing off, and purify them from seeking fame

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلْ فِكْرَهُ وَذِكْرَهُ وَظَعْنَهُ وَإِقَامَتَهُ فِيْكَ وَلَكَ
Translation: And make their thoughts, remembrance, journeying, and staying in You and for You

Arabic text: فَإِذَا صَافَّ عَدُوَّكَ وَعَدُوَّهُ فَقَلِّلْهُمْ فِيْ عَيْنِهِ
Translation: And when they face Your enemy and theirs, make the enemy appear few in their eyes

Arabic text: وَصَغِّرْ شَأنَهُمْ فِيْ قَلْبِهِ
Translation: And diminish their importance in their hearts

Arabic text: وَأَدِلْ لَهُ مِنْهُـمْ وَلَا تُدِلْهُمْ مِنْهُ
Translation: And grant them victory over the enemy, and do not let the enemy prevail over them

Arabic text: فَإِنْ خَتَمْتَ لَهُ بِالسَّعَادَةِ وَقَضَيْتَ لَهُ بِالشَّهَادَةِ
Translation: And if You seal for them with happiness and decree for them martyrdom

Arabic text: فَبَعْدَ أَنْ يَجْتَاحَ عَدُوَّكَ بِالْقَتْلِ
Translation: Let it be after they have destroyed Your enemy with killing

Arabic text: وَبَعْدَ اَنْ يَجْهَدَ بِهِمُ الْأَسْرُ
Translation: And after they have exhausted the enemy with captivity

Arabic text: وَبَعْدَ أَن تَأمَنَ أَطرَافُ المُسْلِمِيْنَ
Translation: And after the borders of the Muslims are secure

Arabic text: وَبَعْدَ أَنْ يُوَلِّيَ عَدُوُّكَ مُدْبِرِينَ
Translation: And after Your enemy has turned in retreat

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ وَأَيُّمَا مُسْلِم
Translation: O Allah, and for any Muslim

Arabic text: خَلَفَ غَازِيًا أَوْ مُرَابِطًا فِيْ دَارِهِ
Translation: Who takes the place of a warrior or guard in his home

Arabic text: أَوْ تَعَهَّدَ خَالِفِيْهِ فِيْ غَيْبَتِهِ
Translation: Or takes care of those left behind in his absence

Arabic text: أَوْ أَعَانَهُ بِطَائِفَة مِنْ مَالِهِ
Translation: Or helps him with a portion of his wealth

Arabic text: أَوْ أَمَدَّهُ بِعِتَاد، أَوْ شَحَذَهُ عَلَى جِهَاد
Translation: Or supplies him with equipment, or motivates him for jihad

Arabic text: أَوْ أَتْبَعَهُ فِيْ وَجْهِهِ دَعْوَةً
Translation: Or follows his departure with a prayer

Arabic text: أَوْ رَعَى لَهُ مِنْ وَرَائِهِ حُرْمَةً
Translation: Or protects his honor in his absence

Arabic text: فَأَجِرْ لَهُ مِثْلَ أَجْرِهِ
Translation: Grant him a reward like the warrior's reward

Arabic text: وَزْنًا بِوَزْن وَمِثْلًا بِمِثْل وَعَوِّضْهُ مِنْ فِعْلِهِ
Translation: Weight for weight, and like for like, and compensate him for his deed

Arabic text: عِوَضًا حَاضِرًا يَتَعَجَّلُ بِهِ نَفْعَ مَا قَدَّمَ
Translation: With an immediate compensation by which he quickly experiences the benefit of what he offered

Arabic text: وَسُرُورَ مَا أَتَى بِهِ، إِلَى أَنْ يَنْتَهِيَ بِهِ الْوَقْتُ
Translation: And the joy of what he did, until the time comes

Arabic text: إلَى مَاأَجْرَيْتَ لَـهُ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
Translation: For what You have provided for him from Your grace

Arabic text: وَأَعْدَدْتَ لَهُ مِنْ كَرَامَتِكَ
Translation: And prepared for him from Your generosity

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ وَأَيُّمَا مُسْلِمٍ أَهَمَّهُ أَمْرُ الْاِسْلاَمِ
Translation: O Allah, and for any Muslim who is concerned about the affairs of Islam

Arabic text: وَأَحْزَنَهُ تَحَزُّبُ أَهْلِ الشِّرْكِ عَلَيْهِمْ
Translation: And is saddened by the alliance of the polytheists against them

Arabic text: فَنَوَى غَزْوًا أَوْ هَمَّ بِجهَـاد
Translation: So he intends to fight or resolves to strive

Arabic text: فَقَعَدَ بِـهِ ضَعْفٌ أَوْ أَبطَأَتْ بِهِ فَاقَةٌ
Translation: But is held back by weakness or delayed by poverty

Arabic text: أَوْ أَخَّرَهُ عَنْهُ حَادِثٌ
Translation: Or is kept back by some incident

Arabic text: أَوْ عَرَضَ لَهُ دُوْنَ إِرَادَتِهِ مَانِعٌ
Translation: Or faces an obstacle preventing his intention

Arabic text: فَاكْتُبِ اسْمَـهُ فِيْ الْعَابِدِيْنَ
Translation: Write his name among the worshippers

Arabic text: وَاَوْجِبْ لَهُ ثَوَابَ الْمُجَاهِدِيْنَ
Translation: And grant him the reward of the strivers

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلْهُ فِيْ نِظَامِ الشُّهَدَاءِ وَالصَّالِحِيْنَ
Translation: And place him in the company of the martyrs and the righteous

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ صَـلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِكَ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad, Your servant and Your messenger

Arabic text: وَ آلِ مُحَمَّد صَلاَةً عَالِيَةً عَلَى الصَّلَوَاتِ
Translation: And upon the family of Muhammad, blessings that rise above all blessings

Arabic text: مُشْرِفَةً فَوْقَ التَّحِيَّاتِ
Translation: And exceed all greetings

Arabic text: صَلاَةً لَا يَنْتَهِيْ أَمَدُهَا
Translation: Blessings whose duration does not end

Arabic text: وَلَا يَنْقَطِعُ عَدَدُهَا
Translation: And whose number does not cease

Arabic text: كَأَتَمِّ مَـا مَضَى مِنْ صَلَوَاتِكَ
Translation: Like the most complete of Your blessings that have passed

Arabic text: عَلَى أَحَد مِنْ أَوْلِيَـائِكَ
Translation: Upon any of Your beloved ones

Arabic text: إِنَّـكَ الْمَنَّانُ الْحَمِيدُ
Translation: Indeed, You are the Beneficent, the Praiseworthy

Arabic text: اَلْمُبْدِئُ الْمُعِيدُ
Translation: The Originator, the Restorer

Arabic text: اَلفَعَّالُ لِمَا تُرِيْدُ
Translation: The Doer of whatever You desire
